Anthropic reports multi-agent at about 15x chat tokens and resumes from the failure point rather than restarting; disjoint frontier_scope and session resume are confirmed, and the open cost lever is per-lineage re-execution of 2.4k-line YAML with inline programs. Value H, effort M.
Co-STORM ends sessions on user request and keeps a hierarchical mind map comparable to the node store; it offers no automatic stop rule to borrow.
